question: In which year did Rudolf Virchow develop his ideas by publishing his famous formula 'Omnis cellula-e cellula', which became a part of the foundation of cell theory?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1855**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rudolf Virchow** was a renowned **German **physician, anthropologist, pathologist, prehistorian, biologist, and politician.
 
• In **1855**, Virchow published his famous formula** *'Omnis cellula-e cellula'***, which translates to **"every cell originates from another existing cell like it"**.
 
• This concept became a fundamental part of the **cell theory**, which is a cornerstone of modern biology.
 
• The cell theory explains that all living organisms are composed of cells, and the cell is the basic unit of life.
 
• Virchow’s work was crucial in understanding the process of cell division and the continuity of life.
